description: This file defines runtime management functions and types for handling task runs and task flows within the OpenClaw plugin system, including session binding, task retrieval, listing, resolution, and cancellation.

classes.name: BoundTaskRunsRuntime
classes.description: Interface representing runtime operations for task runs, including session management, retrieval, listing, resolution, and cancellation.

classes.name: PluginRuntimeTaskRuns
classes.description: Interface for creating and managing task run runtime instances from session or tool context.

classes.name: BoundTaskFlowsRuntime
classes.description: Interface representing runtime operations for task flows, including session management, retrieval, listing, resolution, and summary.

classes.name: PluginRuntimeTaskFlows
classes.description: Interface for creating and managing task flow runtime instances from session or tool context.

classes.name: PluginRuntimeTasks
classes.description: Aggregated interface containing task runs, flows, and legacy flow access.

methods.name: createBoundTaskRunsRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime object for managing task runs within a specific session, with methods for get, list, findLatest, resolve, and cancel.

methods.name: createBoundTaskFlowsRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime object for managing task flows within a specific session, with methods for get, list, findLatest, resolve, and getTaskSummary.

methods.name: createRuntimeTaskRuns
methods.description: Creates a runtime object for task runs, providing methods to bind sessions and create from tool context.

methods.name: createRuntimeTaskFlows
methods.description: Creates a runtime object for task flows, providing methods to bind sessions and create from tool context.

methods.name: createRuntimeTasks
methods.description: Creates an object aggregating task runs, flows, and legacy task flow access, based on provided parameters.
